summary: Ovintiv Inc. filed a Form 8-K on May 11, 2026, reporting first quarter 2026 financial and operating results. The filing includes an earnings release and supplemental financial information (Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2) under Item 2.02, and a declaration of a $0.30 per share quarterly dividend payable June 30, 2026 under Item 8.01. The results show cash from operations of $1.1 billion, Non-GAAP cash flow of $1.2 billion, and free cash flow of $634 million. Also noted is the prior closing of the NuVista Energy acquisition. This is a routine earnings announcement with a regular dividend declaration, not a special situation event.
